item.title: Can’t Sleep? Try Listening to Old Oscars Ceremonies
item.description: IndieWire's Marcus Jones brings his awards-season expertise to an extra-special midnight "movie" genre.

item.title: Cassavetes Was Wrong! Why ‘Boxcar Bertha’ Belongs in the Canon
item.description: Martin Scorsese's second feature, an exploitation picture made on assignment for drive-in mogul Roger Corman, has long been undervalued — a new 4K UHD edition celebrates it in the context of the director's body of work.

item.title: The Surprisingly Long Shelf-Life of ‘American Dad!’
item.description: In 2005, the Seth MacFarlane series seemed like a cheap "Family Guy" clone. 20 years later, it's the best animated show of its generation.

item.title: You Can Now Own a Shooting Script for Akira Kurosawa’s ‘Throne of Blood’
item.description: You have to have about $95,000, though. It's on auction this weekend at the California International Antiquarian Book Fair, and a Peter Harrington bookseller tells IndieWire why this shooting script is especially unique.

item.title: Who Would Win a 2026 Best Stunt Design Oscar, According to IndieWire
item.description: We'll have to wait two more years to see stunts properly acknowledged at the Oscars, but that didn't stop us from choosing our favorites of 2025.

item.title: ‘One Battle After Another’ Takes Top Prize at 2026 PGA Awards (Complete Winners List)
item.description: The Darryl F. Zanuck Award for Outstanding Producer of Theatrical Motion Pictures has predicted the Best Picture winner in 17 of the last 22 years.

item.title: WGA West Cancels Los Angeles Award Show as Staff Continues to Strike
item.description: Next week's Writers Guild of America Awards will be a single coast event, as the New York ceremony will continue as planned.

item.title: ‘Industry’ Finale: Inside the Last Shot and That Weird Flash Frame
item.description: Creators Mickey Down and Konrad Kay on how the last shot works as a nod to “Mad Men" and where the blink-and-you'll-miss-it flash frame hints at Whitney's ultimate fate.

item.title: ‘Sinners’ Wins SAG’s Actor Award for Cast Ensemble in a Motion Picture
item.description: Michael B. Jordan also claimed the best actor prize. See all the winners here.

item.title: ‘Sinners’ Scores Big Actor Awards Wins. Will Oscar Votes Follow?
item.description: BAFTA and PGA Award wins seemed to give the Oscar momentum to "One Battle After Another," but Ryan Coogler's Warner Bros. hit made it clear that the race is far from over on Sunday night.
